The main takeaway from our work is that
linear probing can outperform fine-tuning when the right features are selected.
linear probing can be improved by leveraging the intermediate representations of the source model, which is an important step towards more efficient OOD transfer.
intermediate layers can be exploited to improve OOD generalization, without fine-tuning, and at a much lower cost than fine-tuning.
